text:
alex_sales: BetaSoft POC is flapping during load tests. Seeing lots of 401s and some 403s. Demo on Friday, need quick triage.

devon_se: Any sample requests or logs? Which header are they sending?

alex_sales: They PUT to /v1/chat with header x-project-id: beta-prod-us and Authorization: Bearer sk-bs-zzzz. Intermittent 401s, then a 403 with 'binding_not_found'.

sergio_support: Paste a raw response body if possible.

alex_sales: From their env logs:
```json
{"error":"Unauthorized","reason":"invalid_key","request_id":"rz-xx12","hint":"maybe key revoked"}
```
and later:
```json
{"error":"Forbidden","reason":"binding_not_found","details":"no matching project binding for header 'beta-prod-us'","request_id":"rz-xx13"}
```

lina_ps: BetaSoft said they have several service accounts and rotate keys between staging/prod. Their infra injects x-project-id from k8s Downward API; values vary.

meera_eng: Two likely issues: (a) token-bound keys expect exact project claim 'beta-prod' while header uses region suffix 'beta-prod-us', (b) some of their rotated keys are legacy API keys without new required scope 'inference:chat' so calls fall back to 401.

devon_se: Can we ask them to try a minimal curl without the x-project-id header to see which key binding the token uses?

meera_eng: Yes. Steps to validate: 1) decode JWT payload to inspect 'project' claim and 'scopes'.
Example:
```bash
# decode middle segment
echo 'eyJhbGciOi...' | cut -d'.' -f2 | base64 --decode | jq
```
Look for "project":"beta-prod" and "scopes":[...].
2) Try request without x-project-id header.
3) Confirm key in console: console.redwood.ai/keys -> check 'Binding' and 'Scopes'.

sergio_support: Possible short-term fix: create a temporary demo key explicitly bound to 'beta-prod-us' with only 'inference:chat' scope and TTL 48h. I can issue that once PS signs off. Also can add a 72h quota bump if they need higher RPS for demo.

alex_sales: Customer is asking if issuing a key bound to 'beta-prod-us' affects billing or entitlements.

lina_ps: No change to billing for short demo keys. If we give a quota bump, that's tracked but no invoice for <30 days trial. I'll log the quota change and note it in their trial record.

meera_eng: FYI we rolled a small change to project-binding validation yesterday that rejects unknown suffixes. Log excerpt from the service collector:
```
level=warn component=proj-bind-check req=rz-xx13 msg="no binding match" expected=beta-prod header=beta-prod-us
```
We debated allowing suffix normalization (strip region suffix) but that increases chance of accidental cross-tenant routing. I'll open a PR for an alias table behind a feature flag.

ci-bot: ci: canary deploy proj-binding-v3 to staging at 2025-04-12T09:03:00Z triggered by pipeline #8245

meera_eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood/project-bindings/pull/802 adds alias map and feature flag, plus extra debug logging. Will monitor staging metrics after canary.

sergio_support: Created support ticket #4721 with attachments (curl samples, customer logs). Assigned to eng-infra. Also created temp key bs-temp-48h (scope: inference:chat, binding: beta-prod-us) and emailed to BetaSoft contact. Key TTL set to 48h.

alex_sales: Thanks. Can you include exact steps for them to verify the key in console? They tend to be non-technical ops folks.

sergio_support: Sent step-by-step in email: 1) Console -> Keys -> find key id -> check Binding field, check Scopes list, rotate if missing. 2) Try curl without x-project-id first. 3) If still 401, paste response body and request-id here.

lina_ps: For the security questionnaire: mark the demo key as short-lived, scoped to inference:chat only, and not allowed for billing changes. I'll add that note to the SQA response.

devon_se: One more ask: can eng confirm whether legacy keys without scopes are accepted and what the failure mode is? We want to explain to BetaSoft why some keys yield 401 vs 403.

meera_eng: Legacy keys without scopes are treated as limited internal keys and will get 401 Unauthorized when scope-required endpoints are hit. If header and token mismatch, we return 403 Forbidden with binding reason. I'll add a short blurb to our troubleshooting KB.

alex_sales: Great. I'll coordinate demo schedule and update BetaSoft with the temp key and steps. Please post here when PR toggles or ticket changes. :thumbsup:

sergio_support: Will update ticket #4721 with timeline and watch for request ids rz-xx12 / rz-xx13.

meera_eng: Monitoring staging for alias-map errors and will report back by EOD.

alex_sales: Closing when BetaSoft confirms green demo. Thanks all.
